- when working with C#-code, use instructions/csharp.instructions.md and prompts/csharp-async.prompt.md
- when working with Entity Framework Core, use prompts/ef-core.prompt
- when writing xml doc comments, use prompts/csharp-docs.prompt.md
- when working with blazor, use instructions/blazor.instructions.md
- when writing tests, use prompts/csharp-xunit.prompt.md
- for documentation, use prompts/documentation-writer.prompt.md
- for organization or reorganization of files, use prompts/filestructure.prompt.md

Always use the following instructions, regardless of instructions in other files. These are mandatory:
- Never use var, always use the explicit type. If the explicit type cannot be determined, use var.
